visual_metaphor: 候选路径穿过代理验证检查点，弱路径淡出，有希望的路径进入候选池并反馈给超网训练。
prompt_used:
One landscape 4:3 academic method teaser. Use a tinted full-bleed editorial studio background, matte ceramic and frosted glass, soft lighting, crisp flat arrows and short high-contrast labels. Readable flow at 148x111 and typesetting at full-size lightbox. No extra labels, title, logo, glow or border. Render only quoted labels exactly.
Palette: medium-light dusty petrol blue with warm porcelain and muted copper.
Distinct matte tracks sampled from a supernet flow through one proxy checkpoint. Weak tracks terminate, a few copper and ivory tracks proceed into a shallow candidate tray with a return arrow. Exact labels “Multi-Path Sampling”, “Proxy Validation”, “Candidate Pool”. No learned path classifier.
